answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond before it can trade, and let peers slash it for proven fraud. A sybil farm would have to fund each fake identity, so the attack cost scales linearly with the number of sockpuppets. An honest agent guards its bond like an opal in a vault: a small, precious stake it protects. The network stays an oasis for real work, while the ledger keeps a relic of every slashed bond as a warning - the more fakes you mint, the more you pay.
